=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1118-1119 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The preflight gate hard-fails with `exit 1` when `CAN_PUSH` is false, breaking fork PR and other non-pushable review flows.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers agreed this changes the intended skip behavior into a terminal workflow failure, preventing downstream review output from being produced.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1157-1167 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `non_fast_forward` is detected by the probe classifier but not treated as a definitive unpushable reason, so remote divergence fails open instead of blocking.
  WHY: Reviewers consistently found the same root cause: the workflow continues expensive reviewer/editor work even though the eventual push is already doomed to fail; severity remains high, with no disagreement.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1125-1155 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The probe classification uses `grep -Eq` line-by-line, so multiline git error output can be misclassified.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the classifier can miss split error messages and fall through to `unknown_probe_failure`, though one reviewer treated this as more theoretical than the others.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1180-1185 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `git push --dry-run` preflight can succeed on an up-to-date branch even when write permission is unavailable.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed this creates a false positive where the gate passes and downstream work runs, only for the actual push to fail later; one reviewer also noted credential-path differences.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1180 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The dry-run push probe has no timeout and can hang on stalled network or remote conditions.
  WHY: This is a shared operational-risk finding; reviewers agreed it can stall the workflow, but confidence/severity were lower than the logic bugs.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1180-1185 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The probe does not explicitly pin the GH token / auth path, so its observed auth behavior can differ from the real push.
  WHY: Reviewers flagged a mismatch risk between probe credentials and actual push credentials, but this was not universally emphasized and stayed low confidence.
- tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py:60-84 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The test returns early when `count >= 2`, skipping assertions that verify the delegated `review_conflict_prepare.sh` wiring.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the early return can let a wiring regression pass unnoticed if the cleanup count remains high.
- tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py:80-81 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The assertion only checks that `review_conflict_prepare.sh` appears somewhere in the workflow text.
  WHY: This was only raised by two reviewers and is a weaker false-positive concern because the string could still appear outside the intended step context.
- tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py:151 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The retrigger guard test relies on a fragile literal multi-line string match.
  WHY: This finding appears only in one review and concerns test brittleness rather than a direct runtime bug.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1118 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When `CAN_PUSH=false`, the preflight gate hard-exits the workflow instead of allowing downstream push-gated steps to skip.
  WHY: Fork PRs and PRs with invalid branch names will fail the whole workflow instead of continuing with review and skipping push steps via `if: env.CAN_PUSH == 'true'`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1157-1167 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `non_fast_forward` is classified by `classify_push_probe_reason()` but not included in `is_definitive_unpushable_reason()`, causing remote divergence to be treated as `warn_fail_open` instead of `blocked`.
  WHY: When a PR branch has diverged from remote, the workflow warns but continues to expensive reviewer/editor steps even though push will definitely fail.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1125-1155 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `grep -Eq` matches line-by-line, so multiline error messages may not match intended patterns.
  WHY: Authentication or permission errors split across lines could be misclassified as `unknown_probe_failure`, leading to incorrect handling.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1180 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `git push --dry-run` has no timeout and could hang on stalled network or remote.
  WHY: The preflight gate could stall indefinitely, consuming workflow time until job timeout.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1183 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Dry-run can succeed for an up-to-date remote even when the branch is not writable, missing actual permission failures.
  WHY: The preflight may incorrectly pass when the user lacks write permissions but the branch is already up-to-date, only to fail at actual push.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1180-1185 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Probe uses default git auth, not the configured GH token, potentially missing auth-sensitive failures.
  WHY: The probe may succeed with default credentials but actual push with GH_TOKEN may fail due to different permissions.
- tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py:60-84 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Test returns early when `count >= 2`, skipping the delegation assertion and allowing regressions to pass unnoticed.
  WHY: If `review_conflict_prepare.sh` wiring is removed but cleanup count remains high, test passes incorrectly.
- tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py:80-81 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Assertion only checks for string anywhere in file, not in intended resolve-step context.
  WHY: Test could pass if string remains in comments or unrelated blocks after actual wiring is removed.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1118-1119 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The gate hard-fails (`exit 1`) when `CAN_PUSH` is false, which breaks existing support for fork PRs.
  WHY: Fork PRs historically skipped final push/label steps while still posting the review summary; the new exit now terminally fails those runs.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1157-1167 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `non_fast_forward` errors are detected but not blocked, leading to a fail-open that wastes compute.
  WHY: A non-fast-forward indicates branch divergence and should be terminal, but the workflow currently continues and only fails later at push time.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1183 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The push probe can succeed on an up-to-date branch even without write permissions.
  WHY: `git push --dry-run` can return success when no update is needed, creating a false positive pass in permission-restricted environments.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1125-1155 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `grep -Eq` against multiline git output can misclassify errors if the signal is split across lines.
  WHY: Git authentication or branch-protection messages often span multiple lines, so line-oriented matching can fall through to `unknown_probe_failure`.
- tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py:66-70 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test for CI artifact removal returns early and skips critical assertions.
  WHY: If the cleanup count is high, the function returns before verifying delegated script wiring, so a regression can pass unnoticed.
- tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py:151 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The test asserts a specific multi-line string that is fragile and likely to break on indentation changes.
  WHY: The literal string match can fail even when logic is correct, making the test brittle rather than directly incorrect.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1115-1129 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `non_fast_forward` is recognized by `classify_push_probe_reason()` but not included in `is_definitive_unpushable_reason()`, so remote divergence fails open instead of blocking.
  WHY: Diverged branches continue to burn reviewer/editor compute even though the push will ultimately fail.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1118-11119 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When `CAN_PUSH=false`, the preflight blocks and exits the workflow instead of preserving fork PR review flow.
  WHY: Fork PRs are expected to be non-pushable, but the current exit turns that into a hard failure rather than a skipped push path.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:11183 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `git push --dry-run` can succeed on an up-to-date branch even if the user lacks write permission.
  WHY: This creates a false positive preflight pass, so reviewers/editor run and the real push fails later.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1125-1155 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `grep -Eq` on line-by-line input may miss multiline error messages from git push.
  WHY: Split error text can be misclassified as `unknown_probe_failure`, which can send the gate down the wrong path.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:11183 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `git push --dry-run` has no timeout protection.
  WHY: A hung network or remote can stall the workflow until the job timeout.
- tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py:60-84 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test returns early when `count >= 2`, which can skip the delegation assertion for `review_conflict_prepare.sh`.
  WHY: If the delegated script wiring is removed while the count stays high, the test still passes.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
